item.title: Cycle 1 · Establishing Project on Neurodivergence Capstone Frameworks
item.description:
We are initiating our first research cycle by establishing a project focused on neurodivergence. Utilizing recent Crossref metadata, we will analyze academic capstone structures and digital tools designed for neurodivergent contexts.
